rationale: Gold assertions.must_include_ids requires T1005, T1020, T1027, T1039, T1046 (all present in the narrative), and the extended gold.ex_gold neighbor pool of 13 techniques (T1005, T1020, T1027, T1039, T1046, T1080, T1082, T1083, T1102, T1119, T1199, T1202, T1537) is also fully surfaced — the narrative lists all 13 by both ATT&CK ID and correct name, matching the 13 records returned in logic_flow.results[0].records exactly (e.g. T1046 Network Service Discovery, T1537 Transfer Data to Cloud Account, T1080 Taint Shared Content, etc.). The claims[] block only cites 8 of the 13 techniques (missing explicit citation entries for T1005, T1202, T1082, T1119, T1080), a minor provenance-structuring gap since deterministic_scores.provenance reports 8/8 compliant citations, but this does not affect the correctness or groundedness of the narrative itself since those facts are still directly grounded in the evidence records. No hallucinations found; row_count matches the min_records:5 threshold well beyond minimum.
